neighbours.label: the verb 'provide' (provide / provides / provided / providing), strongest in its formal sense of making provision or stipulating ('as provided by law', 'Nature has provided', 'provides for')
fire: Members shall be elected in the manner provided by the charter of the society.
Heaven has provided the valley with a mild climate and deep soil.
The will provides for the education of his two nieces until they come of age.
Unless otherwise provided in this agreement, payment is due within thirty days.
A prudent farmer provides against a bad harvest by storing grain.
The law provides that no person shall be tried twice for the same offence.
The old king had provided his daughters with large estates before he died.
The treaty provides for the free passage of merchant ships through the strait.
